book.title: Rig Veda
book.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
book.license: Public domain translation (Griffith, 1896); transcription from Wikisource. Griffith’s commentary and notes are not included.
book.notes: Complete translation in Griffith’s arrangement: ten Maṇḍalas, one chapter per hymn, one verse per stanza. The Sanskrit text and Griffith’s commentary are not included. Hymn 1.179, which the 1896 edition prints only as an appendix note, is absent.

verses.translation: THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy The speckled sap runs like a flood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine, Enrobed in water with his juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne'er subdued in waters, waterless, And make it pure for Indra's drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve: By wisdom it hath gained its home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee, Contending for the glorious prize.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Swelling, as 'twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, Soma, purifying him who knoweth song mid living men, Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vrtras, full of zeal, The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth: To Indra flow the Soma-streams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows into the sieve, Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong At sacrifices through the lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as 'twere above light's triple realm, And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, the head of sacrifice, singers and bards have sung their songs, Offering what he loves to see.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong steed, Deck thee for service of the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home, Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offspring of thy sap: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halves: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine: Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass, Hath sunk and settled in his home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant, The mothers of the darling Son.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine who long to meet their Lord, The kine who yield the shining milk?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies: O Pavamana, find us wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r, Whether he be afar or near.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousand fold treasure in the shape Of cattle to the singing-men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts As such, O Soma, find us fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords, Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious King, into the songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean With hands, is resting in the jars.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve, Lending the laud a Hero's strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood. Exhilarating, finding light;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly Bringing their praiser vital force.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir, And fall into the river's wave.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired, Like coursers harnessed to a car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire On him who yet hath given us naught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel: Flow pure and shining with the stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course, And roused the good man's hymn to life.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds, Like cars, like armies hurried forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like The flickering flames of burning fire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns, Have gained by song their hearts' desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain To reach the regions and their paths.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Advancing they have travelled o'er the ridges of the earth and heaven, And this the highest realm of all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out, And this which must be deemed most high.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls: Thou calledst forth the out spun thread.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink, For sacred lore of every kind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come. They made the Sun that he might shine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth, And give us food with progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink, Turned to the vat which drips with meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma grows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength, Brave Hero who repels the curse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods: Indu, thou fain wilt win us strength
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes: Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed, the drops while they are purified: When blent, in waters they are rinsed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink: The men have seized and lead thee forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men, To him who ruleth o'er mankind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art, Ready for Indra's high decree.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on, best Vrtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds. Pure, purifying, wonderful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath effused, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vayu and the Marut host.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Pass into Vayu as Law bids.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home, Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified, Thither where the Immortals sit.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise, The visitor of living men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream To seat thee in the place of song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed Upon the lap of Aditi,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams, To Indu who supporteth heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, they Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, dweller with Vivasvan, they with use of both arms have sent forth, The Lord of Speech infallible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones Send down to ridges of the sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee Who aidest song and cheerest him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vayu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven, Effused into the vats of wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed, Still Conqueror, never overcome.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then Mounts up with Surya to the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed, This Indu, being purified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient, Runs to the woolen straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused, Entering all their essences.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Pavamana, swift and strong, Omniscient, gave splendour to The Sun and all his forms of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused, Of him who sets him by the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed, Brought forth as light that merits laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth: Fill full the sea that claims our praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream Drive to one place our enemies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all, That so we may be freed from blame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven, And splendid vigour, in thy stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth: While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified. Sends forth a very mighty sound.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream man conquering might which many crave, Accompanied with hero sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream, To settle in the vats of wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets, O Indu, to be Indra's drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets, Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified, Bestowing wealth which all may see.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, high o'er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might: The Master of all strength be thou.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee Soma, they multiply thy power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-Place of strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk. Aloft on the sublimest height.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms, With thee, O Lord of all that is.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have Flowed forth to glorify our prince.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn: He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runnest like a darting deer Set in the place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love He came as to a settled race.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me, Glory, intelligence, and wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed Onward, as buffaloes to woods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra, Vayu, Varuna, to Visnu, and the Maruts, flow The drops of Soma juice effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk: The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise: They decorate the Child of Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas Filled full of riches thousand fold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled. Rending strong places with its might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Poured forth to Indra, Varuna, to Vayu and the Marut hosts, To Visnu, flows the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong: They milk the liquor out with skill.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: 'Tis he whom Trita must refine, 'tis he who shall make Indra glad: The Tawny One is decked with tints.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him do the Sons of Prsni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice, Oblation lovely and most dear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him in one united stream these songs flow on straight forward. he, Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream. Wherewith thou mayest find us light
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on, Bearer of wealth to us with might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies: Let what is precious flow to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power, Discovering holy works and means.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified Soma, the Guardian of the folk;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most rich as he is purified. The people all have set their hearts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve: The Steed steps forward to the goal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve, Turned to the vat that drops with meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us. Speed us to mental power and skill.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned, Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament Upon the liberal worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine, And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent, Bellowing, to his place of rest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Vrtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne'er deceived, Hath gone, as 'twere, to win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood, Indu to Indra willingly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woolen filter, as he goes To war that wins a thousand spoils.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One Indu to Indra for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright And beauteous for the gladdening draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men. Speeding like lover to his love.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Poured for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth, intelligent, crying out, Unto the well-beloved place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With might, bestowing power, the juice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down From heaven upon the straining cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One. Sit in the place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice: He settles in his firm abode.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousand fold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splendours hitherward: Find for us food in boundless store.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper, And prosper thou the singer's hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doubly piled, Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss, Leaving the bridge of woe behind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain Lightnings are flashing to the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth, As Dawn, as Surya with his beams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasa flows around the world.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued, Robed in the waters and the milk,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused Flows purely on, a God for Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers Are purified for winning spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve: He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired, He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil, Send us abundant store of food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed, Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs, Songs of the sage Medhyatithi.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us, Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods, Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee: Soma, bestow heroic power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as 'twere thy wave to Gods, Unwearied, thou art flowing forth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away, The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve Soma, most active, travels on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice: The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vayu, Sage And Hero, lead us to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers, Win for us strength and high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to The Gods, O better than our friends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy: Unbar for us the doors of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run Indu belongs unto the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece: Singers have chanted Indu's praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man Who worships thee heroic strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods, joying in mountains, flowing on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Vayu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful Like a bride dowered by her sire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of juice, the Somas rich in food, Give strength to Indra with their work.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal, And cook with milk the gladdening draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us, Giver of ample opulence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn, The draught that shall make Indra glad.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity: joyous he riseth like a bull.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest: He sternly reckoneth their debts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes A thousand-winning thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage When he embellisheth his songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war Thou art upon the conquerors' side.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might In mansions of the lofty heavens;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway, Destroyer of a hundred forts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down, Lord over riches, from the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend Of all, the speeder through the air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty, Most active, ready to assist.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky, And plenteous store of wholesome food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us, The kine of strangers to our home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Pour down on us a flood of rain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth For verily the Gods will bear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Raksasas, Flashing out splendour as of old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One, Even Pavamana, dropping meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer, To seat thee in the place of song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm, Indu, for Indra, for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones, And make it pure for Indra's drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamana's flowing meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse, O Steer, the singer, for our help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve: Flow on to give us strength and fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice, Flow to the filter when effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams Run o'er the fleecy straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men, Of him who threatens us with war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea, A thousand of thy pure bright streams.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves: Chase thou the foes who compass us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked: With fearless heart will I sing praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws: Crush him who fain would fight with thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed, Indu the bringer of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes, Seven currents flowing through the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist- Soma, a God as Surya is.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend, Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment, And, Soma, all felicities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy, Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams To Indra's friendship win their way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love: O Soma, thou art decked to win.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Visnu: guard The men, the singers, from distress.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He flows beholding on his way all well beloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants. Sits as a falcon in the, wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified, All treasures both of heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purusanti's hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside: Swift runs this giver of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FLOW onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight: Bring hither wealth with progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants: Flow onward from the pressing-boards.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, as Pavamana, pass over all trouble and distress: Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Pavamana, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great: O Indu, thou art over all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamana, laud Indu who sees with thousand eyes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, they Have filtered through the fleecy cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Pavamana, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars, Finding his way to Indra's heart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal: Bring genial seed with progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FLOW onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delight Battered the nine-and-ninety down,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga, For pious Divodasa's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And, Indu, food in boundless store.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o'er The limit of the cleansing sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve, Soma; be gracious unto us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides, for thou canst, Riches and food with hero sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautify With the Adityas is he seen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with, the beams Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pusan flow For Mitra and for Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Strong sheltering power and great renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man, Yea, all the glories of mankind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk Increase the sea that merits laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From heaven hath Pavamana made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamana, King! Flows o'er the woollen straining-cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vrtra who Compassed and stayed the mighty floods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons: Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war: Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, Going to Indra's special place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when fain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enemies away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may we Subdue all those who war with us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down- Guard us therewith from every foe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THESE rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve To bring us all felicities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny, Yea, and the warrior steed, success.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Ila flow To us for noble eulogy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy: Hawk-like he settles in his home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by men The milch-kine sweeten it with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice for Ambrosia, for the festival.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink, Finding thine home in vats of wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Indu, for the Angirases.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana, sent to us For lofty friendship, meditates.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamana shall Bring treasures to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour thou upon us thousand fold possessions, both of kine and steeds, Exceeding glorious, much-desired.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused, Made beautiful by living men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage, With countless wealth and endless help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Born on the mountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down, As in her sheltering nest a bird.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed by the men, as 'twere to war hath Soma Pavamana sped, To test with might within the vats.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated car By the Seven Rsis' holy songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war, Swift Steed who carries off the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar, Stands like a hero mid the kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught: Gods for the Gods milk out the meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets, Him whom the Gods most gladly hear.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for lofty fame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids, For holy lore of every kind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, thou who movest all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might: For thy behoof the rivers flow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flow To the bright fleece spread under them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong, Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, true, Pavamana, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve, Giving his praiser hero strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: POUR hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength, And keep renown secure for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners! Within the cups thou seatest thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra and for Visnu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar: May Vayu find it rich in sweets.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrifice Have flowed through twisted obstacles,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength, Driving away the godless ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate place Flow through the region hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Surya light, Urging on waters good to men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Pavamana, high o'er man yoked the Sun's courser Etasa To travel through the realm of air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might come Indu, he said, is Indra's self.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hence, singers, pour the gladdening juice to Vayu and to Indra, pour The drops upon the fleecy cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma Pavamana, find wealth for us not to be assailed, Wealth which the foeman may not win.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine, Send spoil of war and high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Surya, floweth on his way, Pouring the juice within the jar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice, Worshipful laws and strength in kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk, Effused for Indra Thunder-armed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods, Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams, Indu, the giver of delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons, Bring hither strength in herds of kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs. For battle as it were in war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs: Loud bellowing the Steer comes on,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice, Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vayu mount as Law commands
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown: Enter the lake, as one we love.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight: Drive off the folk who love not Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops, Driving all enemies afar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamana been effused Upon the summit of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy stream All foes, all Raksasas away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Driving the Raksasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for us Most excellent and splendid strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earth and heaven, Indu, all boons to be desired.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steer like sway: Thou as a Steer ordainest laws.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steer strong thy wood, steer-like thy drink A Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men, Flow onward to the fleecy cloth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper From heaven and earth and firmament.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Finder of all, have been effused, Even as Surya's rays of light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form Soma, thou swellest like a sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana; thou hast moved, Like the God Surya, to the sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns: So starts the charioteer his steed-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive, Alighting in the home of Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men: Indu with sheen approach the milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk, Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place, Resplendent, guided by the strong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juice Have flowed, urged onward, to the lake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake, Yea, to the place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might: Guard, hero like, our sheltering home.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loud neighs the Courser Etasa, with singers, harnessed for the place, Guided for travel to the lake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice, He leaves the foolish far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice: Down sink the unintelligent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets, To sit in place of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well: The living make thee beautiful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine: O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech. Thousand fold, with the lore of hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to us Speech thousand fold that longs for war.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend. Of these men enter thou the lake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly. And form that utters loud acclaim.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil, Like warriors when they stand arrayed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us, Flow like the Sun for us to see.
