verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They harness to the broad-wheeled car the mighty Courser whose back bears meath, unwearied, awful. The twins, the sisters brighten him, and strengthen-these children of one dame the vigorous Racer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Four pouring out the holy oil attend him, sitting together in the same container. To him they flow, when purified, with homage, and still, from every side, are first about him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He is the buttress of the heavens, supporter of earth, and in his hand are all the people. Be the team's Lord a well to thee the singer: cleansed is the sweet plant's stalk for deed of glory.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fighting, uninjured come where Gods are feasted; Soma, as Vitra-slayer flow for Indra. Vouchsafe us ample riches very splendid may we be masters of heroic vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: URGED On, the Father of the Earth and Heaven hath gone forth like a car to gather booty, Going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, and in his hand containing every treasure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the tones of sacred song have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the Life-bestower. Dwelling in wood as Varuna in rivers, lavishing treasure he distributes blessings
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Great Conqueror, warrior-girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches; With sharpened. arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both earth and heaven with all their fulness. Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, gladden Varuna and Mitra; cheer, Indu Pavamana! Indra, Visnu. Cheer thou the Gods, the Company of Maruts: Indu, cheer mighty Indra to rejoicing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus like a wise and potent King flow onward, destroying with thy vigour all misfortunes. For our well-spoken hymn give life, O Indu. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As for a chariot-race, the skillful Speaker, Chief, Sage, Inventor, hath, with song, been started. The sisters ten upon the fleecy summit drive on the Car-horse to the resting places.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The drop of Soma, pressed by wise Nahusyas, becomes the banquet of the Heavenly People- Indu, by hands of mortal men made beauteous, immortal, with the sheep and cows and waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Steer roaring unto Steer, this Pavamana, this juice runs to the white milk of the milch-cow. Through thousand fine hairs goes the tuneful Singer, like Sura by his fair and open pathways.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Break down the, strong seats even of the demons: cleansing thee, Indu, robe thyself in vigour. Rend with thy swift bolt, coming from above them, those who are near and those who yet are distant.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Prepare the forward paths in ancient manner for the new hymn, thou Giver of all bounties. Those which are high and hard for foes to conquer may we gain from thee, Active! Food-bestower!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So purifying thee vouchsafe us waters, heaven's light, and cows, offspring and many children. Give us health, ample land, and lights, O Soma, and grant us long to look upon the sunshine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE gold-hued juice, poured out upon the filter, is started like a car sent forth to conquer. He hath gained song and vigour while they cleansed him, and hath rejoiced the Gods with entertainments.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who beholdeth man hath reached the filter: bearing his name, the Sage hath sought his dwelling. The Rsis came to him, seven holy singers, when in the bowls he settled as Invoker.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Shared by all Gods, most wise, propitious, Soma goes, while they cleanse him, to his constant station. Let him rejoice in all his lofty wisdom to the Five Tribes the Sage attains with labour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In thy mysterious place, O Pavamana Soma, are all the Gods, the Thrice-Eleven. Ten on the fleecy height, themselves, self-prompted, and seven fresh rivers, brighten and adorn thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now let this be the truth of Pavamana, there where all singers gather them together, That he hath given us room and made the daylight, hath holpen Manu and repelled the Dasyu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As the priest seeks the station rich in cattle, like a true King who goes to great assemblies, Soma hath sought the beakers while they cleansed him, and like a wild bull, in the wood hath settled.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: TEN sisters, pouring out the rain together, swift-moving thinkers of the sage, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as a youngling crying to his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along to waters. As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the. chose meeting-place, the beaker.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow: thither in streams goes very sapient Indu. The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the Head and Chief with milk within the vessels.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all the Gods, O Indu Pavamana, while thou art roaring send us wealth in horses. Hither upon her car come willing Plenty, inclined to us, to give us of her treasures.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now unto us mete riches, while they cleanse thee, all-glorious, swelling wealth, with store of heroes. Long be his life who worships, thee, O Indu. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHEN beauties strive for him as for a charger, then strive the songs like soldiers for the sunlight. Acting the Sage, he flows enrobed in waters and song as 'twere a stall that kine may prosper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The worlds expand to him who from aforetime found light to spread the law of life eternal. The swelling songs, like kine within the stable, in deep devotion call aloud on Indu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When the sage bears his holy wisdom round him, like a car visiting all worlds, the Hero, Becoming fame, mid Gods, unto the mortal, wealth to the skilled, worth praise mid the Ever-present,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For glory born be hath come forth to glory: he giveth life and glory to the singers. They, clothed in glory, have become immortal. He, measured in his course, makes frays successful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Stream to us food and vigour, kine and horses: give us broad lights and fill the Gods with rapture. All there are easy things for thee to master thou, Pavamana Soma, quellest foemen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loud neighs the Tawny Steed when started, settling deep in the wooden vessel while they cleanse him. Led by the men he takes the milk for raiment: then shall he, through his powers, engender praise-songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As one who rows drives on his boat, he, Gold-hued, sends forth his voice, loosed on the path of Order. As God, the secret names of Gods he utters, to be declared on sacred grass more widely.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hastening onward like the waves of waters, our holy hymns are pressing nigh to Soma. To him they come with lowly adoration, and, longing, enter him who longs to meet them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They drain the stalk, the Steer who dwells on mountains, even as a Bull who decks him on the upland.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sending thy voice out as Director, loosen the Invoker's thought, O Indu, as they cleanse thee. While thou and Indra rule for our advantage, may we be masters of heroic vigour.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: IN forefront of the cars forth goes the Hero, the Leader, winning spoil: his host rejoices. Soma endues his robes of lasting colours, and blesses, for his friends, their calls on Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Men decked with gold adorn his golden tendril, incessantly with steed-impelling homage. The Friend of Indra mounts his car well-knowing, he comes thereon to meet the prayer we offer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O God, for service of the Gods flow onward, for food sublime, as Indra's drink, O Soma. Making the floods, bedewing earth and heaven, come from the vast, comfort us while we cleanse thee
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow for prosperity and constant Vigour, flow on for happiness and high perfection. This is the wish of these friends assembled: this is my wish, O Soma Pavamana.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward the Father of the earth, Father of heaven: Father of Agni, Surya's generator, the Father who begat Indra and Visnu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brahman of Gods, the Leader of the poets, Rsi of sages, Bull of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, Axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises. Beholding these inferior powers in cattle, he rests among them as a Steer well-knowing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Gladdener, Warrior never harmed in battle, with thousand genial streams, pour strength and vigour. As thoughtful Pavamana, urge O Indu, speeding the kine, the plant's wave on to Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dear, grateful to the Gods, on to the beaker moves Soma, sweet to Indra, to delight him. With hundred powers, with thousand currents, Indu, like a strong car-horse, goes to the assembly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Born in old time as finder-out of treasures, drained with the stone, decking himself in waters, Warding off curses, King of all existence, he shall find way for prayer the while they cleanse him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For our sage fathers, Soma Pavamana, of old performed, by thee, their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As thou didst flow for Manu Life-bestowing, Foe-queller, Comforter, rich in oblations, Even thus flow onward now conferring riches: combine with Indra, and bring forth thy weapons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward, Soma, rich in sweets and holy,. enrobed in waters on the fleecy summit. Settle in vessels that are full of fatness, as cheering and most gladdening drink for Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour, hundred-streamed, winner of thousands, mighty at the Gods' banquet, Pour the rain of heaven, While thou with rivers roarest in the beaker, and blent with milk prolongest our existence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purified with our holy hymns, this Soma o'ertakes malignities like some strong charger, Like fresh milk poured by Aditi, like passage in ample room, or like a docile car-horse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cleansed by the pressers, armed with noble weapons, stream to us the fair secret name thou bearest. Pour booty, like a horse, for love of glory God, Soma, send us kine, and send us Vayu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They deck him at his birth, the lovely Infant, the Maruts with their troop adorn the Car-horse. By songs a Poet and a Sage by wisdom, Soma joes singing through the cleansing filter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Light-winner, Rsi-minded, Rsi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, Leader of sages, A Steer who strives to gain his third form, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a Singer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hawk seated in the bowls, Bird wide-extended, the Banner seeking kine and wielding weapons, Following close the sea, the wave of waters, the great Bull tells his fourth form and declares it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like a fair youth who decorates his body, a courser rushing to the gain of riches, A steer to herds, so, flowing to the pitcher, he with a roar hath passed into the beakers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on with might as Pavamana, Indu flow loudly roaring through the fleecy filter. Enter the beakers sporting, as they cleanse thee, and let thy gladdening juice make Indra joyful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His streams have been effused in all their fulness, and he hath entered, balmed with milk, the goblets. Singing his psalm, well-skilled in song, a Chanter, be comes as 'twere to his friend's sister roaring.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Chasing our foes thou comest, Pavamana Indu, besting, as lover to his darling. As a bird flies and settles in the forest, thus Soma settles, purified, in goblets.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With full stream and abundant milk, O Soma, thy beams come, like a woman, as they cleanse thee. He, gold-hued, rich in boons, brought to the waters, hath roared within the goblet of the pious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: MADE pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse the God hath to the Gods his juice imparted. He goes, effused and singing, to the filter, like priest to measured seats supplied with cattle.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in battle, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations. Roll onward to the beakers as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods, and watchful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a Prince among us, nobler than the noble. Roar out as thou art purified, run forward. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let us sing praises to the Gods: sing loudly, send ye the Soma forth for mighty riches. Let him flow, sweetly-flavoured, through the filter, and let our pious one rest in the pitcher.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Winning the friendship of the Deities, Indu flows in a thousand streams to make them joyful. Praised by the men after the ancient statute, he hath come nigh, for our great bliss, to Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow, Gold-hued, cleansing thee, to enrich the singer: let thy juice go to Indra to support him. Come nigh, together with the Gods, for bounty. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The God declares the Deities' generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin, far-ruling, sanctifying, the Boar advances, singing, to the places.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Swans, the Vrsaganas from anear us have brought their restless spirit to our dwelling. Friends come to Pavamana meet for praises, and sound in concert their resistless music.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He follows the Wide-strider's rapid movement: cows low, as 'twere, to him who sports at pleasure. He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the Silvery shines by night, by day the Golden.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, to make him joyful. He quells malignities and slays the demons, the King of mighty power who brings us comfort.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter- Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens, for the God's enjoyment.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As he is purified he pours out treasures, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices. Indu hath, wearing qualities by seasons, on the raised fleece engaged, the ten swift fingers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Red Bull bellowing to the kine advances, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. Well is he beard like Indra's shout in battle: letting this voice be known he hastens hither.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet flavours, urging the meath-rich plant thou goest onward. Raising a shout thou flowest as they cleanse thee, when thou, O Soma, art effused for Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, aiming death-shafts at him who stays the waters, Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine, O Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pleased with us, Indu, send us as thou flowest good easy paths in ample space and comforts. Dispelling, as 'twere with a club, misfortunes, run o'er the height, run o'er the fleecy summit.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour on us rain celestial, quickly streaming, refreshing, fraught with health and ready bounty. Flow, Indu, send these Winds thy lower kinsmen, setting them free like locks of hair unbraided.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Part, like a knotted tangle, while they cleanse thee, O Soma, righteous and unrighteous conduct. Neigh like a tawny courser who is loosened, come like a youth, O God, a house-possessor.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For the God's service, for delight, O Indu, run o'er the height, run o'ver the fleecy summit. With thousand streams, inviolate, sweet-scented, flow on for gain of strength that conquers heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Without a car, without a rein to guide them, unyoked, like coursers started in the contest, These brilliant drops of Soma juice run forward. Do ye, O Deities, come nigh to drink them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So for our banquet of the Gods, O Indu, pour down the rain of heaven into the vessels. May Soma grant us riches sought with longing, mighty, exceeding strong, with store of heroes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What time the loving spirit's word had formed him Chief of all food, by statute of the Highest, Then loudly lowing came the cows to Indu, the chosen, well-loved Master in the beaker.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Sage, Celestial, liberal, raining bounties, pours as he flows the Genuine for the Truthful. The King shall be effectual strength's upholder: he by the ten bright reins is mostly guided.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who beholds mankind, made pure with filters, the King supreme of Deities and mortals, From days of old is Treasure-Lord of riches: he, Indu, cherishes fair well-kept Order.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Haste, like a steed, to victory for glory, to Indra's and to Vayu's entertainment. Give us food ample, thousandfold: be, Soma, the finder-out of riches when they cleanse thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused by us let God-delighting Somas bring as they flow a home with noble heroes. Rich in all boons like priests acquiring favour, the worshippers of heaven, the best of Cheerers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So, God, for service of the Gods flow onward, flow, drink of Gods, for ample food, O Soma. For we go forth to war against the mighty make heaven and earth well stablished by thy cleansing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, yoked by strong men, neighest like a courser, swifter than thought is, like an awful lion. By paths directed hitherward, the straightest, send thou us happiness, Indu, while they cleanse thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sprung from the Gods, a hundred streams, a thousand, have been effused: sages prepare and purge them. Bring us from heaven the means of winning, Indu; thou art-forerunnner of abundant riches.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The streams of days, were poured as 'twere from heaven: the wise King doth not treat his friend unkindly. Like a son following his father's wishes, grant to this family success and safety.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now are thy streams poured forth with all their sweetness, when, purified. thou goest through the filter. The race of kine is thy gift, Pavarridna: when born thou madest Surya rich with brightness.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bright, bellowing aiong the path of Order, thou shinest as the form of life eternal. Thou flowest on as gladdening drink for Indra, sending thy voice out with the hymns of sages.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pouring out streams at the Gods' feast with service, thou, Soma, lookest down, a heavenly Eagle. Enter the Soma-holding beaker, Indu, and with a roar approach the ray of Sarya.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Three are the voices that the Courser utters: he speaks the thought of prayer, the law of Order. To the Cow's Master come the Cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Soma come the Cows, the Milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring. Soma, effused, is purified and blended our hymns and Trstup songs unite in Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified flow for our welfare. Pass into Indra with a mighty roaring make the voice swell, and generate abundance.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Singer of true songs, ever-watchful, Soma hath settled in the ladles when they cleanse him. Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cleansed near the Sun as 'twere he as Creator hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them. He by whose dear help men gain all their wishes shall yield the precious meed as to a victor.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, being cleansed, the Strengthener and Increaser, Soma the Bounteous, helped us with his lustre, Wherewith our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and stole the cattle from the mountain.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the first vault of heaven loud roared the Ocean, King of all being, generating creatures. Steer, in the filter, on the fleecy summit, Soma, the Drop effused, hath waxen mighty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma the Steer, in that as Child of Waters he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra; he, Indu, generated light in Surya.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make Vayu glad,, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee. Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward righteous slayer of the wicked, driving away our enemies and sickness, Blending thy milk with milk which cows afford us. We are thy friends, thou art the Friend of Indra.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour us a fount of meath, a spring of treasure; send us a hero son and happy fortune. Be sweet to India when they cleanse thee, Indu, and pour down riches on us from the ocean.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong Soma, pressed, like an impetuous courser, hath flowed in stream as a flood speeding downward. Cleansed, he hath settled in his wooden dwelling: Indu hath flowed with milk and with the waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong, wise, for thee who longest for his coming this Soma here flows to the bowls, O Indra. He, chariot-borne, sun-bright, and truly potent, was poured forth like the longing of the pious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He, purified with ancient vital vigour, pervading all his Daughter's forms and figures, Finding his threefold refuge in the waters, goes singing, as a priest, to the assemblies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, chariot-borne, flow unto us, God Soma, as thou art purified flow to the saucers, Sweetest in waters, rich in meath, and holy, as Savitar the God is, truthful minded.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To feast him, flow mid song and hymn, to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra. Flow to the song-inspiring car-borne Hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders. God Soma, send us chariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us, when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth, So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rsihood in Jamadagni's manner.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu. Here, too, the Ruddy, wind-swift, full of wisdom, Shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory. May the Foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prsana, wrought in battle. He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou comest unto three extended filters, and hasteriest through each one as they cleanse thee. Thou art the giver of the gift, a Bhaga, a Maghavan for liberal lords, O Indu.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This Soma here, the Wise, the All-obtainer, flows on his way as King of all existence. Driving the drops at our assemblies, Indu completely traverses the fleecy filter.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Great Inviolate are kissing Indu, and singing in his place like eager sages. The wise men send him forth with ten swift fingers, and balm his form with essence of the waters.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, may we, with thee as Pavamana, pile up together all our spoil in battle. This boon vouchsafe us Varuna and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: STREAM on us riches that are sought by many, best at winning strength Riches, O Indu, thousand fold, glorious, conquering the great.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused, he hath, as on a car, invested him in fleecy mail: Onward hath Indu flowed in streams, impelled, surrounded by the wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece: He goes erect, as seeking kine in stream, with light, to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thou thyself, O Indu, God, to every mortal worshipper Attractest riches thousand fold, made manifest in hundred forms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Good Vrtra-slayer, may we be still nearest to this wealth of thine Which many crave, nearest to food and happiness, Resistless One!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the pair of pressing stones The wavy Friend whom Indra loves-the twice-five sisters dip and bathe,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the Deities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through longing for this sap of yours ye drink what brings ability, Even him who, dear as heaven's own light, gives to our princes high renown.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu at holy rites produced you, Heaven and Earth, the Friends of men, Hill-haunting God the Goddesses. They bruised him where the roar was loud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For Vrtra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, Poured for the guerdon-giving man, poured for the God who sitteth there.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These ancient Somas, at the break of day, have flowed into the sieve, Snorting away at early morn these foolish evil-hearted ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this Most Resplendent One. Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THEY for the Bold and Lovely One ply manly vigour like a bow: joyous, in front of songs they weave bright raiment for the Lord Divine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And he, made beautiful by night, dips forward into strengthening food', What time the sacrificer's thoughts speed on his way the Golden-hued.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his the juice which Indra chiefly drinks--- That which kine took into their mouths, of old, and princes take it now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, while purifying, they have raised the ancient psalm of praise: And sacred songs which bear the names of Gods have supplicated him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They purify him as he drops, courageous, in the fleecy sieve. Him they instruct as messenger to bear the sage's morning prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, best Cheerer, takes his seat, the while they cleanse him in the bowls. He as it were impregns the cow, and babbles on, the Lord of Song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He is effused and beautified, a God for Gods, by skillful men. He penetrates the mighty floods collecting all he knows therein.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed, Indu, guided by the men, thou art led to the cleaning sieve. Thou, yielding Indra highest joy, takest thy seat within the bowls.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Guileless Ones are singing praise to Indra's well beloved Friend, As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, while they cleanse thee bring, O Soma, doubly-waxing wealth Thou in the worshipper's abode causest all treasures to increase.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Set free the. song which mind hath yoked, even as thunder frees the rain: All treasures of the earth and heaven, O Soma, thou dost multiply.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy stream when thou art pressed runs on like some victorious warrior's steed Hastening onward through the fleece like a fierce horse who wins the prize.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on, Sage Soma, with thy stream to give us mental power and strength, Effused for Indra, for his drink, for Mitra and for Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, best winner, thou, of spoil, O Soma, as most rich in sweets for Indra, Visnu, and the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mothers, void of guiles, caress thee Golden-coloured, in the sieve, As cows, O Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Pavamana, movest on with wondrous rays to great renown. Striving within the votary's house thou drivest all the glooms away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth. Thou, Pavamana hast assumed thy coat of mail in majesty.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FOR first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward, Indu, is like an able steed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The men with all-pervading song send unassailable Soma forth, By pressing-stones, to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow, Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu flows on for Indra's sake: thus have the Deities declared. The Lord of Speech exerts himself, Ruler of all, because of might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows, Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the Friend of Indra, day by day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As Pusan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. He, Lord of the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The dear cows lowed in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. The drops as they were purified, the Soma juices, made then paths.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of our weal, Effused as friends without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused by means of pressing-stones, upon the ox-hide visible, They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These Soma juices, skilled in song, purified, blent with milk and curd, When moving and when firmly laid in oil, resemble lovely Suns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the power of men restrain the voice of the outpouring juice: As Bhrgu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the greedy hound away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Friend hath wrapped him in his robe, as in his parents arms, a son. He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That Hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart, Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve, to settle, priest-like, in his place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma upon the ox's skin through the sheep's wool flows purified. Bellowing out, the Tawny Steer goes on to Indra's special place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE Child, when blended with the streams, speeding the plan of sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The place, near the two pressing-stones of Trita, hath he occupied, Secret and dear through seven lights of sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urge to three courses, on the heights of Trita, riches in a stream. He who is passing wise measures his courses out.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even at his birth the Mothers Seven taught him, for glory, like a sage, So that he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Under his sway, of one accord, are all the guileless Deities: Warriors to be envied, they, when they are pleased.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Babe whom they who strengthen Law have generated fair to see, Much longed for at the sacrifice, most liberal Sage,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him, united, of themselves, come the young Parents of the rite, When they adorn him, duly weaving sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With wisdom and with radiant eyes unbar to us the stall of heaven, Speeding at solemn rite the plan of Holy Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Soma who is purified as ordering Priest the song is raised: Bring meed, as 'twere, to one who makes thee glad with hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Blended with milk and curds he flows on through the long wool of the sheep. The Gold-hued, purified, makes him three seats for rest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows: The Rsis' sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Shared by all Gods, Infallible, the Leader of our holy hymns, Golden-hued Soma, being cleansed, hath reached the bowls.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: After thy Godlike qualities, associate with Indra, go, As a Priest purified by priests, Immortal One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like a car-horse who shows his strength, a God effused for Deities. The penetrating Pavamana flows along.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SIT down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself: Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Unite him bringing household wealth, even as a calf, with mother kine, Him who hath double strength, the God, delighting juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purify him who gives us power, that he, most Blessed One, may be A banquet for the Troop, Mitra, and Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Voices have sung aloud to thee as finder out of wealth for us: We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indu, art the food of Gods, O Sovran of all gladdening drinks: As Friend for friend, be thou best finder of success.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive utterly away from us each demon, each voracious fiend, The godless and the false: keep sorrow far away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: SING; ye aloud, O friends, to him who makes him pure for gladdening drink: They shall make sweet the Child with sacrifice and laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent, Glorified by our hymns, the God-delighting juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effectual means of power is he, he is a banquet for the Troop, He who hath been effused, most rich in meath, for Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow to us, Indu, passing, strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds: I will spread forth above the milk thy radiant hue.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the tawny, Indu thou who art the God's most special food, As Friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious foe. O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra, to the Mighty Steer, may these gold-coloured juices go, Drops rapidly produced, that find the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused, this juice victorious flows for Indra, for his maintenance. Soma bethinks him of the Conqueror, as he knows.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Indra in his raptures gain from him the grasp that gathers spoil, And, winning waters, wield the steer strong thunderbolt.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou on: Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do thou, all-beautiful, purify for Indra's sake the mighty juice, Path-maker thou, far seeing, with a thousand ways.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Best finder of prosperity for us, most rich in sweets for Gods, Proceed thou loudly roaring on a thousand paths.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indu, with thy streams, in might, flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight: The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified, Pouring down rain from heaven in hoods, and finding light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Shouting while purified before the voice of song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With songs they send the Mighty forth, sporting in wood, above the fleece: Our psalms have glorified him of the triple height.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Into the jars hath he been loosed, like an impetuous steed for war, And lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gold-hued and lovely in his course, through tangles of the wool he flows, And pours heroic fame upon the worshippers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow thus, a faithful votary: the streams of meath have been effused. Thou comest to the filter, singing, from each side.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HENCE sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, Who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams. He hath pressed Soma out with stones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece inviolate and most odorous. We ladden thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, Far-sighted One, is mental power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe: Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Milking the heavenly udder for dear meath, he hath sat in the ancient gathering place. Washed by the men, the Strong Farseeing One streams forth nutritious food that all desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, while they cleanse thee, dear and watchful in the sheep's long wool, Thou hast become a Singer most like Angiras: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bountiful, best of furtherers, Soma floweth on, Rsi and Singer, keen of sight. Thou hast become a Sage most welcome to the Gods: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes, even as with a mare, in tawny coloured stream, goes in exhilarating stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Down to the water-Soma, rich in kine hath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessel as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, Thou, entering the saucers as a man the fort, gold-hued hast settled in the wood.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, like an impetuous steed in war, Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma,-for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, With the stalk's juice, exhilarating, resting not, into the vat that drops with meath.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like a dear son who must be decked, the Lovely One hath clad him in a shining robe. Men skillful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their bands.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink, Intelligent drops above the basin of the sea, exhilarating, finding light.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite: May he by Mitra's and by Varuna's decree flow furthering the lofty rite.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose home is in the sea-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host: He hastens o'er the fleece with all his thousand streams: men make him bright and beautiful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Purified in the bowl and gendering the hymn, wise Soma joys among the Gods. Robed in the flood, the Mighty One hath clad himself with milk and settled in the vats.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me; help me, thou Tawny-hued; pass on beyond these barriers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Close to thy bosom am I, Soma, day and night. O Tawny-hued, for friendship sake. Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we o'ertaken in his course like birds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Deft-handcd! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Making thee pure and bright in the sheep's long wool, tbou hast bellowed, steer like, in the wood. Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana, balmed with milk unto the special place of Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on to win us strength, flow on to lofty lore of every kind. Thou, Soma, as Exhilarator wast the first to spread the sea abroad for Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow to the realm of earth, flow to the realm of heaven, O Soma, in thy righteous ways. Fair art thou whom the sages, O Far-seeing One, urge onward with their songs and hymns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream, Girt by the Maruts, gladdening, Steeds with Indra's strength, for wisdom and for dainty food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urged onward by the pressers, clad in watery robes, Indu is speeding to the vat. He gendering light, hath made the glad Cows low, while he takes them as his garb of state.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FOR Indra, flow thou Soma on, as gladdening juice most sweet, intelligent, Great, cheering, dwelling most in heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer. drinking of this that finds the light, He, Excellently Wise, is come to strengthening food, to spoil and wealth like Etasa.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For, verily, Pavamana, thou bast, splendidest, called all the generations of The Gods to immortality.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By whom Dadhyac Navagva opens fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrta in the felicity of Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the long wool of the sheep, Sporting, as 'twere the waters' wave.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who from out the rocky cavern took with might the red refulgent watery Cows, Thou masterest the stable full of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laudworthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, roan in wood;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Increaser of the water, Steer with thousand streams, dear to the race of Deities; Who born in Law hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty Ordinance.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make splendid glory shine on us, thou Lord of strengthening food, God, as the Friend of Gods: Unclose the fount of middle air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Roll onward to the bowls, O Mighty One, effused, as Prince supporter of the tribes. Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the waters' flow: incite our thoughts to win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They have drained him the Steer of heaven, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy, Him who brings all things excellent.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Mighty One was born Immortal, giving life, lightening darkness with his shine. Well-praised by. sages he hath. by his wondrous power assumed the Threefold as his robe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us bounteous gifts and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman, By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna and Indra for our great defence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, for Indra's drink do thou, led by the men, well-weaponed and most gladdening, Flow on with greatest store of sweets.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Enter the Soma-holder, even Indra's heart, as rivers pass into the sea, Acceptable to Mitra, Vayu, Varuna, the noblest Pillar of the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: PLEASANT to Indra's Mitra's, Pusan's Bhaga's taste, sped onward, Soma, with thy flowing stream.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all Deities for strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast, immortal dwelling-place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods to every form.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods and Heaven and Earth and bless our progeny.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, bright Juice, art Sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true Law.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream through the great fleece as in the olden time.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bom, led by men, joyous, and purified, let the Light-finder make all blessings flow:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu, while cleansed, keeping the people safe, shall give us all possessions for our own.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Flow on for wisdom, Soma, and for power, as a strong courser bathed, to win the prize.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The pressers purify this juice of thine, the Soma, for delight, and lofty fame
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They deck the Gold-hued Infant, newly born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve for Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, Sage for good fortune in the waters' lap.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He bears the beauteous name of Indra, that wherewith he overcame all demon foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All Deities are wont to drink of him, pressed by the men and blent with milk and curds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He hath flowed forth with thousand streams effused, flowed through the filter and the sheep's long wool.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With endless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra's throat.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The mighty Soma with a thousand streams is poured to Indra through the cleansing sieve.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu they balm with pleasant milky juice for Indra, for the Steer, for his delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lightly, for sheen, they cleanse thee for the Gods, gold-coloured, wearing water as thy robe.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indu to Indra streams, yea, downward streams, Strong, flowing to the floods, and mingling -there.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O'ERPOWERING Vrtras, forward run to win great strength: Thou speedest to subdue like one exacting debts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In thee, effused, O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight. Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, thou didst generate the Sun, and spread the moisture out with power, Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou didst produce him, Deathless God mid mortal men for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrta: Thou evermore hast moved making strength flow to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as 'twere a never-failing well for men to drink, Borne on thy way in fragments from the presser's arms.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Then, beautifully radiant, certain Heavenly Ones, have sung to him their kinship as they looked thereon, And Savitar the God opens as 'twere a stall.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Soma, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown: So, Hero, urge us onward to heroic power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old primeval milk of heaven that claims the laud: They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As long as thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might, Thou standest like a Bull the chief amid the herd.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In the sheep's wool hath Soma Pavamana flowed, while they cleanse him, like a playful infant, Indu with hundred powers and hundred currents.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Holy and sweet, while purified, this Indu flows on, a wave of pleasant taste, to Indra,- Strength-winner, Treasure-finder, Life. bestower.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So flow thou on, subduing our assailants, chasing the demons hard to been countered, Well-armed and conquering our foes, O Soma.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sara with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst; thou with thy mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with songs of worship in thine home. As 'twere from far, the hymn is heard, where holy songs resound in joy. He with the ruddy-hued, threefold hath won life-power, he, glittering, hath won life-power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He moves intelligent, directed to the East. The very beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE all have various thoughts and plans, and diverse are the ways of men. The Brahman seeks the worshipper, wright seeks the cracked, and leech the maimed. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The smith with ripe and seasoned plants, with feathers of the birds of air, With stones, and with enkindled flames, seeks him who hath a store of gold. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A bard am I, my dad's a leech, mammy lays corn upon the stones. Striving for wealth, with varied plans, we follow our desires like kine. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The horse would draw an easy car, gay hosts attract the laugh and jest. The male desires his mate's approach, the frog is eager for the flood, Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET Vrtra-slaying Indra drink Soma by Saryanavan's side, Storing up vigour in his heart, prepared to do heroic deeds. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the Quarters, flow thou on, boon Soma, from Arjika land, Effused with ardour and with faith, and the true hymn of sacrifice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither hath Surya's Daughter brought the wild Steer whom Parjanya nursed. Gandharvas have seized bold of him, and in the Soma laid the juice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Splendid by Law! declaring Law, truth speaking, truthful in thy works, Enouncing faith, King Soma! thou, O Soma, whom thy maker decks. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Together flow the meeting streams of him the Great and truly Strong. The juices of the juicy meet. Made pure by prayer, O Golden-hued, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavamana, where the priest, as he recites the rhythmic prayer, Lords it o'er Soma with the stone, with Soma bringing forth delight, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Pavarnana, place me in that deathless, undecaying world Wherein the light of heaven is set, and everlasting lustre shines. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make me immortal in that realm where dwells the King, Vivasvan's Son, Where is the secret shrine of heaven, where are those waters young and fresh. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make me immortal in that realm where they move even as they list, In the third sphere of inmost heaven where lucid worlds are full of light. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make me immortal in that realm of eager wish and strong desire, The region of the radiant Moon, where food and full delight are found. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Make me immortal in that realm where happiness and transports, where Joys and felicities combine, and longing wishes are fulfilled. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE man who walketh as the Laws of Indu Pavamana bid, Men call him rich in children, him, O Soma, who hath met thy thought. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Kasyapa, Rsi, lifting up thy voice with hymn-composers' lauds, Pav reverence to King Soma born the Sovran Ruler of the plants. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Seven regions have their several Suns; the ministering priests are seven; Seven are the Aditya Deities,-with these, O Soma, guard thou us. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Guard us with this oblation which, King Soma, hath been dressed for thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni! The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here, being manifested, lofty Visnu, full wise, protects his own supremest station. When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
